articles.title: 'KILLERS OF OUR CHILDREN': Mojtaba's CHILLING Threat To Bezos, Musk; AI Video BLOWS Up US Tech Firms
articles.description: Iran has issued a chilling warning to some of America's biggest technology companies, releasing an AI-generated video depicting attacks on the headquarters of Amazon, Microsoft and Elon Musk's SpaceX. Shared by Iranian state-affiliated Mehr News Agency, the disturbing footage shows buildings engulfed in flames and targeted by drones, accompanied by an ultimatum demanding companies allegedly linked to US and Israeli military operations either pay reparations and repent or face destruction. The warning invokes the deadly Minab elementary school strike, which killed 175 people, mostly children. The development comes amid escalating tensions between Washington and Tehran, with US President Donald Trump warning that renewed military strikes against Iran could follow after the new year.

Various food service providers have been engaged to prepare and deliver meals across different routes. Meal weights have been reduced, yet the portion sizes remain unchanged.
